messages:
maya: Quick sync — we need a fast go/no-go for the SDK/docs/sample-app release. Targeting v1.4.0 tomorrow 10:00 PT. Changelog cutoff is EOD today. Who has final signoff on packaging and the sample apps?

samir: I can own SDK packaging (publishing to npm/pypi). I’ll bump the package metadata and run the smoke publish in staging. ETA 2h.

tess: I’ll do docs review and the quickstart checklist. Two docs PRs outstanding: https://github.com/redwood/devex-docs/pull/412 and /413. Need a tech review on the auth snippet in 413.

chris: Sample app owner here — I pushed fixes for env handling, tests are passing locally. CI flaky on the integration suite though (see logs). Will try to re-run.

leo: re: CI, I’ll requeue the flaky job and monitor. If it fails again we should skip the long integration test for the release candidate and add a post-release follow-up ticket.

maya: Important: changelog entries must be tagged in this PR list: https://github.com/redwood/devex/releases/compare/v1.3.9...v1.4.0. If you haven’t added an entry, add one now or reply here with your changes.

samir: Added packaging changelog and publish notes. Also created release script snippet:

```
# release to staging
npm run build && npm publish --tag next
python -m pip install --upgrade twine && twine upload --repository staging dist/*
```

chris: Tests re-run passed on the sample app but one e2e is slow. I trimmed DB setup and improved retries. Pushed patch to https://github.com/redwood/sample-apps/pull/89.

tess: Docs PR 413 updated with the correct auth code sample, @chris can you sanity check the example token flow?

chris: Quick look — LGTM. Left one inline about expiration example.

maya: Deployment policy: we will gate full public release until both SDK packages are published and sample apps land. If either misses the window, we do a staged rollout tomorrow (hosted API first, SDKs follow). OK? :thinking_face:

samir: Fine with me. I need green from packaging CI and someone to approve the pypi token rotation step.

leo: Approved the token rotation in the secrets manager. I’ll coordinate the handoff when you publish.

deploy-bot: [deployment note] Release candidate build 1.4.0-rc.1 created: build/rc/1779001200 — artifacts available at https://ci.redwood/builds/1779001200

maya: Action items summary:
- samir: publish npm/pypi (owner)
- tess: docs final review + merge (owner)
- chris: merge sample-apps PR + fix slow e2e (owner)
- leo: monitor CI + approve secrets handoff (owner)
- maya: coordinate go/no-go and perform final smoke tests on staging (owner)

If you’re blocked, call it out now. Otherwise we’ll reconvene in 3h for a final signoff.

tess: One blocker — we still need a tiny legal blurb for sample app telemetry. @maya can you ping legal?

maya: On it, pinged legal in #people-ops, copy sent.

samir: Packaging CI is green for npm, pypi had a transient failure on upload but twine retry worked. Published to staging.

chris: Sample app PR merged. Pushed a tag v1.4.0-sample.

leo: CI green after requeue. No other failures observed.

maya: OK — we have a green path for staging. Final checklist before public release:
- changelog entries present :white_check_mark:
- SDK published to npm/pypi :white_check_mark:
- docs merged :white_check_mark:
- sample apps tagged :white_check_mark:
- legal blurb confirmed :white_check_mark:

I’ll start the public rollout at 10:00 PT tomorrow unless anyone raises a late blocker in the next 1h. :rocket:
